exports.authority: visibleState + process projections + Store.evidenceBundle proxy + canonicalEvidenceGraph

ratchetRule: ICTC 1.2 keeps one server semantic authority and seven process-specific business procedures. Standard e Controlli adds a typed benchmark library without becoming legal authority. Global procedure summary aggregates local work signals without inventing a compliance score. AI remains assist/search/proposal only; cross-process changes create review-needed work rather than mutating prior human decisions.
limitations: 1.2 Market Candidate is a bounded product profile, not legal compliance, certification or universal production readiness.
Standard scope is a human decision; a built-in reference does not establish applicability.
Proprietary normative text is not bundled by the open-source distribution without appropriate authorization.
Crosswalks and shared control objectives do not establish legal equivalence or inherited compliance.
A disabled procedure is removed from new operational routing/work and writes while historical records and evidence remain readable.
AI OFF preserves manual business paths; automated periodic discovery requires an enabled AI service.
Execution of remediation and verified closure are distinct checkpoints; closure requires human verification and EvidenceRef.
Evidenze presents recorded decisions, provenance and integrity; this does not establish substantive sufficiency or compliance.
Independent human comprehension and market fit remain not-assessed without E4 evidence.
